title: Deeply unrolled alternating projections for phase retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.17316v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep unrolling methods for inverse problems augment traditional reconstruction algorithms with learned priors to improve their performance. These methods have been developed under the implicit assumption that the geometry of the measurement operator does not change between training and deployment; when this is no longer the case, the quality of obtained reconstructions can degrade significantly. In this paper, we argue that this is not an inherent limitation of the deep unrolling paradigm and can be mitigated by a careful choice of the underlying iterative algorithm. We propose a deep unrolling framework for the phase retrieval problem that augments the alternating projections method with a learned denoising step. Our method obtains high-quality reconstructions without the need for retraining in settings where conventional model-based alternatives struggle, such as when the dynamic range of the measurement operator changes significantly

translated_title: 用于相位恢复的深度展开交替投影方法
translated_abstract: 针对逆问题的深度展开方法通过学习到的先验来增强传统重建算法，以提升其性能。这些方法的开发基于一个隐含假设，即测量算子的几何结构在训练和部署之间保持不变；当这一假设不再成立时，所获得重建结果的质量可能会显著下降。在本文中，我们论证了这并非深度展开范式的固有局限，并且可以通过仔细选择底层迭代算法来缓解这一问题。我们提出了一种针对相位恢复问题的深度展开框架，该框架在交替投影方法的基础上增加了一个学习得到的去噪步骤。在传统基于模型的替代方法难以应对的场景中（例如测量算子的动态范围发生显著变化时），我们的方法无需重新训练即可获得高质量的重建结果。
tldr: 提出了一种将学习到的去噪步骤与交替投影方法相结合的深度展开框架用于相位恢复，在测量算子动态范围显著变化等场景下无需重新训练即可获得高质量重建。
en_tdlr: Proposes a deep unrolling framework for phase retrieval that augments alternating projections with a learned denoising step, achieving high-quality reconstructions without retraining even when the measurement operator's dynamic range changes significantly.
